parameter_set.description: Clone of S10_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11 with the on-site gas turbines removed and primary power supplied by a BC Hydro transmission-voltage grid connection (hydro-dominated system). Same real MIT SuperCloud TX-GAIA GPU job timeline for 2021-08-11 (UTC) and same additive CPU load as S10. All primary energy is grid import, capped at 80 MW at the PCC via grid_import_limit_mw (PROPOSED_HERE: ~125% of the 61.8 MW observed facility peak; covers peak plus the 18 MW BESS charge rate; revised from 60 MW on 2026-10-27, CAV-S11-03). No turbines, solar, or fuel cells. The 18 MW / 14 MWh grid-forming BESS provides ride-through. A 60 MW (6 x 10 MW) diesel block is configured but DISABLED (enabled=false) because the diesel coordinator currently starts on any local gap before grid import is counted; re-enable after a grid-loss gate exists (IMPL-S11-03). No grid-outage event is scripted. grid_import_price_per_mwh 53.74 is BC Hydro RS 1830C (5.374 c/kWh, CAD). BESS initial SoC and diesel sizing are PROPOSED_HERE.
parameter_set.name: S11_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11_bchydro

parameter_set.description: Two-hour Kubernetes, Slurm, and Ray demonstration with 45 MW and 90 MW bursts starting at t=30 s and t=310 s, followed by bursts at t=920 s, t=1850 s, and t=2700 s. Burst durations are 240 s, 300 s, and 600 s for the final three bursts, so workloads do not overlap. Two gas turbines are spinning at 35% minimum stable load from t=0; two more start from hot standby at Burst-02 and the grid-forming BESS bridges their startup gap. GE assumptions: 300-second hot start, 360-second warm start, 600-second cold start, and 30 MW/min ramp.
parameter_set.name: 01 Turbine Scenario with Kubernetes Slurm Ray

parameter_set.description: Constraint-test variant of S11_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11_bchydro, identical except the BC Hydro grid import is deliberately capped at 60 MW (below the 61.8 MW observed facility peak) to exercise import-limit behaviour; expect ~1.8 MW unserved during the largest bursts. Same MIT SuperCloud 2021-08-11 workload, no turbines, 18 MW / 14 MWh grid-forming BESS, diesel block configured but disabled (IMPL-S11-03). Cap value PROPOSED_HERE.
parameter_set.name: S11b_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11_bchydro_60mw
